_contract: the COMPLETE state journal is 61.4 MiB and does not belong in git (AGENTS.md 2.5: heavy bytes stay outside the repository; the run's records carry the durable location and the hash). states_compact.jsonl beside this file holds every field needed to identify, rank or re-materialize a state; what is dropped is the per-layer arch_spec, whose HASH is kept and which is derivable from the recorded path.
_dev_box_only: the out-of-tree artifact store on this development machine. It is NOT a durable backend: nothing off this host holds a copy, so a maintainer decision about durable storage is owed if this journal matters beyond the compact form.
